agents.prompt: Show the test-status distribution of metric rows for reporting month 2026-10-31.
agents.text:
**Interpreted intent**
This counts the metric rows (one row per application, metric and month) for each test status in reporting month 2026-10-31. Each status also shows its share of all rows that month and how many distinct applications it covers.

**Generated SQL**
```sql
WITH __obs AS (
  SELECT
    metric_id,
    test_status,
    eon_id,
    reporting_monthend_date
  FROM METRICS_ANALYZER.MOCK_DATA.APPLICATION_COMPLIANCE
)
SELECT
  o.test_status,
  COUNT(o.metric_id) AS observation_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.eon_id) AS distinct_applications_observed,
```
